+class HYV4DFlySpeculator(DraftModelSpeculator):
+    """Vendor-neutral DFly speculator; vendors bind their draft and attention."""
+
+    can_reuse_target_attn_metadata = False
+    draft_model_cls: ClassVar[type["HYV4DFlyForCausalLM"]]
+    attention_cls: ClassVar[type["HYV4MLAAttention"]]
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, device: torch.device):
+        cache_dtype = vllm_config.cache_config.cache_dtype
+        if cache_dtype not in ("auto", "bfloat16", "fp8_ds_mla"):
+            raise ValueError("DFly requires BF16 or fp8_ds_mla MLA KV cache")
+        spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+        assert spec is not None
+        draft_cache_dtype = spec.kv_cache_dtype or cache_dtype
+        target_dtype = "bfloat16" if cache_dtype == "auto" else cache_dtype
+        draft_dtype = "bfloat16" if draft_cache_dtype == "auto" else draft_cache_dtype
+        if draft_dtype != target_dtype:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "DFly draft and target must use the same MLA KV cache dtype; "
+                "omit speculative_config.kv_cache_dtype to inherit the target"
+            )
+        kv_transfer = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+        if (
+            kv_transfer is not None
+            and kv_transfer.kv_connector != "DecodeBenchConnector"
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("DFly does not support PD disaggregation")
+        if (
+            vllm_config.lora_config is not None
+            or vllm_config.parallel_config.use_ubatching
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("DFly does not support LoRA or microbatching")
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, device)
+        config = super().attn_vllm_config
+        config.model_config = copy(self.draft_model_config)
+        config.parallel_config = copy(vllm_config.parallel_config)
+        config.parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel = False
+        config.parallel_config.is_moe_model = False
+        config.attention_config = copy(config.attention_config)
+        config.attention_config.sparse_mla_force_mqa = True
+        config.attention_config.use_non_causal = False
+        config.compilation_config = copy(config.compilation_config)
+        config.cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
+        config.quant_config = None
+        self._draft_vllm_config = config
+        self.num_query_per_req = self.num_speculative_steps + 1
+        self.uses_mrope = self.draft_model_config.uses_mrope
+        self.target_hidden_states = torch.zeros(
+            self.max_num_reqs, self.hidden_size, dtype=self.dtype, device=device
+        )
+        self.active_requests = torch.zeros(
+            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.bool, device=device
+        )
+        # The target batch row of each request's last accepted token, and the
+        # position of its bonus (anchor) query.
+        self.source_rows = torch.zeros(
+            self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int64, device=device
+        )
+        self.anchors = torch.zeros(self.max_num_reqs, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self.mrope_positions = (
+            torch.zeros(
+                self.draft_model_config.mrope_num_dims,
+                self.max_num_tokens,
+                dtype=torch.int64,
+                device=device,
+            )
+            if self.uses_mrope
+            else None
+        )
+        # Draft logits cache column of each step, as 0-d views.
+        self._step_cols = torch.arange(
+            self.num_speculative_steps, dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+        )
+        self.query_model: HYV4DFlyQueryModel | None = None
+        self.cudagraph_manager: CudaGraphManager | None = None
+        self.reuse: HYV4DFlyTargetReuse | None = None
+        self._storage_validated = False
+        self._slot_mappings: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+    def load_draft_model(
+        self, target_model: nn.Module, target_attn_layer_names: set[str]
+    ) -> nn.Module:
+        config = self._draft_vllm_config
+        config.quant_config = VllmConfig.get_quantization_config(
+            self.draft_model_config, get_draft_load_config(config)
+        )
+        draft = get_model(
+            vllm_config=config,
+            model_config=self.draft_model_config,
+            load_config=get_draft_load_config(config),
+            prefix="dfly",
+        )
+        if not isinstance(draft, self.draft_model_cls):
+            raise TypeError("DFly speculator requires HYV4DFlyForCausalLM")
+        language_model = (
+            target_model.get_language_model()
+            if hasattr(target_model, "get_language_model")
+            else target_model
+        )
+        maybe_share_target_embed(draft, draft.model, language_model.model)
+        head = share_target_lm_head(
+            draft,
+            get_target_lm_head(target_model, language_model),
+            quantization=None,
+        )
+        if head is None or draft.model.embed_tokens is None:
+            raise ValueError("DFly requires compatible target embedding and LM head")
+        if (
+            head.weight.dtype != self.dtype
+            or draft.model.embed_tokens.weight.dtype != self.dtype
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("DFly requires BF16 shared embedding and LM head weights")
+        draft.logits_processor.head_dtype = self.vllm_config.model_config.head_dtype
+        self.reuse = HYV4DFlyTargetReuse(
+            target_model, draft, self.vllm_config, self.attention_cls
+        )
+        self.query_model = HYV4DFlyQueryModel(
+            draft, self.draft_tokens, self._sample_step
+        )
+        config.quant_config = draft.model.quant_config
+        config.model_config.hf_config = draft.config
+        config.model_config.hf_text_config = draft.config
+        logger.info(
+            "HYV4 DFly: %d layers, N=%d, TP=%d, DP=%d (TP-local draft), "
+            "target index/KV=%s/%s, %s writable KV aliases, "
+            "max length=%d, draft quantization=%s, draft sampling=%s",
+            len(draft.model.layers),
+            self.num_speculative_steps,
+            config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size,
+            config.parallel_config.data_parallel_size,
+            draft.config.target_index_layer,
+            draft.config.target_kv_layers,
+            config.cache_config.cache_dtype,
+            self.max_model_len,
+            self.draft_model_config.quantization or "none",
+            self.speculative_config.draft_sample_method,
+        )
+        return draft
+
+    @property
+    def attn_vllm_config(self) -> VllmConfig:
+        return self._draft_vllm_config
+
+    def set_attn(
+        self,
+        model_state: ModelState,
+        kv_cache_config: KVCacheConfig,
+        block_tables: BlockTables,
+        target_input_buffers: InputBuffers,
+        target_attn_groups: list[list[AttentionGroup]],
+        kernel_block_sizes: list[int],
+    ) -> None:
+        super().set_attn(
+            model_state,
+            kv_cache_config,
+            block_tables,
+            target_input_buffers,
+            target_attn_groups,
+            kernel_block_sizes,
+        )
+        assert self.reuse is not None
+        self.reuse.validate_groups(kv_cache_config)
+        self._storage_validated = False
+        self._slot_mappings = torch.full(
+            (len(kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups), self.max_num_tokens),
+            PAD_SLOT_ID,
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+            device=self.device,
+        )
+
+    def init_cudagraph_manager(self, cudagraph_mode: CUDAGraphMode) -> None:
+        query_width = self.num_query_per_req
+        max_reqs = min(self.max_num_reqs, self.max_num_tokens // query_width)
+        if cudagraph_mode.decode_mode() == CUDAGraphMode.FULL:
+            cg_support = self.attn_cg_support
+            if (
+                cg_support.min_cg_support.value
+                >= AttentionCGSupport.UNIFORM_BATCH.value
+            ):
+                # Every query block is a uniform decode batch of query_width
+                # tokens per request, so the whole query step can be one graph.
+                self.cudagraph_manager = CudaGraphManager(
+                    self._draft_vllm_config,
+                    self.device,
+                    CUDAGraphMode.FULL_DECODE_ONLY,
+                    decode_query_lens={query_width: max_reqs},
+                )
+                logger.info(
+                    "DFly CUDA graphs: FULL, %d tokens per request, up to %d requests",
+                    query_width,
+                    max_reqs,
+                )
+                return
+            logger.warning(
+                "DFly draft attention (%s) does not support FULL CUDA graphs; "
+                "using breakable PIECEWISE graphs.",
+                cg_support.min_cg_attn_backend,
+            )
+
+        config = copy(self._draft_vllm_config)
+        config.compilation_config = copy(config.compilation_config)
+        compilation = config.compilation_config
+        request_sizes = set(compilation.decode_cudagraph_capture_request_sizes or ())
+        request_sizes.update(
+            min(cdiv(size, query_width), max_reqs)
+            for size in compilation.prefill_cudagraph_capture_token_sizes or ()
+        )
+        compilation.prefill_cudagraph_capture_token_sizes = sorted(
+            n * query_width for n in request_sizes if 0 < n <= max_reqs
+        )
+        compilation.use_breakable_cudagraph = True
+        mode = (
+            CUDAGraphMode.NONE
+            if cudagraph_mode == CUDAGraphMode.NONE
+            else CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE
+        )
+        self.cudagraph_manager = CudaGraphManager(
+            config, self.device, mode, decode_query_lens={query_width: max_reqs}
+        )
+        if mode != CUDAGraphMode.NONE:
+            assert self.query_model is not None
+            self.cudagraph_manager.init_breakable_cg_runner(self.query_model)
+            logger.info(
+                "DFly CUDA graphs: breakable PIECEWISE, query token buckets=%s; "
+                "sparse attention and metadata remain eager",
+                compilation.prefill_cudagraph_capture_token_sizes,
+            )
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def capture(self) -> None:
+        manager = self.cudagraph_manager
+        if manager is None or not manager.needs_capture():
+            return
+        assert self.reuse is not None
+        self.reuse.validate_storage()
+
+        def create_forward_fn(
+            desc: BatchExecutionDescriptor, warmup: bool
+        ) -> Callable[[CUDAGraphMode], None]:
+            count = desc.num_tokens
+            batch = count // self.num_query_per_req
+            self.block_tables.get_dummy_block_tables(batch)
+            # An all-padding block: no K/V writes, no draft logits writes.
+            self._prepare_query(
+                self._dummy_propose_inputs(), 0, batch, write_slots=True
+            )
+            # A FULL graph keeps the metadata it was captured with, so capture
+            # it for the longest sequences it may replay.
+            self.draft_max_seq_len = (
+                self.max_model_len
+                if desc.cg_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+                else self.num_query_per_req
+            )
+            metadata, slots = self._query_attention_state(
+                desc, torch.zeros(batch, dtype=torch.int32, device="cpu")
+            )
+
+            def forward(cg_mode: CUDAGraphMode) -> None:
+                self._run_query_model(count, metadata, slots, cg_mode)
+
+            return forward
+
+        manager.capture(
+            create_forward_fn, progress_bar_desc="Capturing DFly CUDA graphs"
+        )
+
+    def _dummy_propose_inputs(self) -> DFlyProposeInputs:
+        """Placeholder inputs for dummy runs and capture; never read with
+        `num_reqs=0`."""
+        return DFlyProposeInputs(
+            query_start_loc=self.input_buffers.query_start_loc,
+            positions=self.input_buffers.positions,
+            idx_mapping=self.idx_mapping,
+            num_sampled=self.source_rows,
+            num_rejected=self.source_rows,
+            last_sampled=self.draft_tokens,
+            last_hidden_states=self.target_hidden_states,
+            temperature=self.temperature,
+            seeds=self.seeds,
+        )
+
+    def _prepare_query(
+        self,
+        inputs: DFlyProposeInputs,
+        num_reqs: int,
+        padded_batch: int,
+        write_slots: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Fill the query block, its slots and the draft layers' sparse indices.
+        Rows past `num_reqs` are padding, so `num_reqs=0` gives an all-padding
+        block."""
+        assert self.reuse is not None
+        rope_state = getattr(getattr(self, "model_state", None), "rope_state", None)
+        prepare_dfly_inputs(
+            input_ids=self.input_buffers.input_ids,
+            positions=self.input_buffers.positions,
+            is_padding=self.input_buffers.is_padding,
+            query_start_loc=self.input_buffers.query_start_loc,
+            seq_lens=self.input_buffers.seq_lens,
+            active=self.active_requests,
+            source_rows=self.source_rows,
+            anchors=self.anchors,
+            target_hidden_out=self.target_hidden_states,
+            mrope_positions=self.mrope_positions,
+            draft_idx_mapping=self.idx_mapping,
+            out_temperature=self.temperature,
+            out_seeds=self.seeds,
+            target_query_start_loc=inputs.query_start_loc,
+            target_positions=inputs.positions,
+            idx_mapping=inputs.idx_mapping,
+            num_sampled=inputs.num_sampled,
+            num_rejected=inputs.num_rejected,
+            last_sampled=inputs.last_sampled,
+            target_hidden=inputs.last_hidden_states,
+            mrope_delta=rope_state.prefill_delta.gpu if rope_state else None,
+            temperature=inputs.temperature,
+            seeds=inputs.seeds,
+            max_model_len=self.max_model_len_gpu,
+            mask_token_id=self.model.config.mask_token_id,
+            query_width=self.num_query_per_req,
+            num_reqs=num_reqs,
+            padded_batch=padded_batch,
+        )
+        if write_slots:
+            assert self._slot_mappings is not None
+            for gid, groups in enumerate(self.attn_groups):
+                if groups:
+                    write_dfly_query_slots(
+                        self._slot_mappings[gid],
+                        self.input_buffers.positions,
+                        self.active_requests,
+                        self.block_tables.input_block_tables[gid],
+                        self.block_tables.block_sizes[gid],
+                        self.max_model_len_gpu,
+                        self.num_query_per_req,
+                        padded_batch,
+                    )
+        self.reuse.update_indices(
+            self.active_requests, self.source_rows, self.anchors, padded_batch
+        )
+
+    def _sample_step(self, step: int, hidden: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The draft tokens at query offset `step + 1` of every row."""
+        if self.draft_logits is None:
+            return greedy_argmax(self.model.compute_logits(hidden))
+        batch = hidden.shape[0]
+        # Draws are keyed by the position before the predicted token.
+        pos = self.anchors[:batch] + step
+        return gumbel_sample(
+            self.model.compute_logits(hidden),
+            self.idx_mapping[:batch],
+            self.temperature,
+            self.seeds,
+            pos,
+            apply_temperature=True,
+            is_drafting=True,
+            logits_cache=self.draft_logits.values,
+            logits_cache_col=self._step_cols[step],
+            use_fp64=self.use_fp64_gumbel,
+            logits_cache_row_mapping=self.draft_logits.row_mapping,
+        )
+
+    def _query_attention_state(
+        self, desc: BatchExecutionDescriptor, seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
+        assert self._slot_mappings is not None
+        count = desc.num_tokens
+        batch = count // self.num_query_per_req
+        metadata = self._build_attn_metadata(
+            num_reqs=batch,
+            batch_desc=desc,
+            query_start_loc_np=self.arange_np[: batch + 1] * self.num_query_per_req,
+            seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound,
+            step=self.num_query_per_req,
+            causal=True,
+            slot_mappings=self._slot_mappings[:, :count],
+        )
+        slots = build_slot_mappings_by_layer(
+            self._slot_mappings[:, :count], self.kv_cache_config
+        )
+        return metadata, slots
+
+    def _run_query_model(
+        self,
+        count: int,
+        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None,
+        slots: dict[str, torch.Tensor] | None,
+        cg_mode: CUDAGraphMode,
+    ) -> None:
+        assert self.query_model is not None
+        batch = count // self.num_query_per_req
+        positions = (
+            self.input_buffers.positions[:count]
+            if self.mrope_positions is None
+            else self.mrope_positions[:, :count]
+        )
+        model_inputs = dict(
+            input_ids=self.input_buffers.input_ids[:count],
+            positions=positions,
+            target_hidden=self.target_hidden_states[:batch],
+            active=self.active_requests[:batch],
+        )
+        with set_forward_context(
+            metadata,
+            self._draft_vllm_config,
+            num_tokens=count,
+            cudagraph_runtime_mode=cg_mode,
+            batch_descriptor=BatchDescriptor(num_tokens=count),
+            slot_mapping=slots,
+            is_padding=self.input_buffers.is_padding[:count],
+        ):
+            if cg_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE:
+                assert self.cudagraph_manager is not None
+                self.cudagraph_manager.run_pw_graph(self.query_model, model_inputs)
+            else:
+                self.query_model(**model_inputs)
+
+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def propose(
+        self,
+        input_batch: InputBatch,
+        attn_metadata: dict[str, Any],
+        slot_mappings: dict[str, torch.Tensor],
+        last_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] | None,
+        num_sampled: torch.Tensor,
+        num_rejected: torch.Tensor,
+        last_sampled: torch.Tensor,
+        next_prefill_tokens: torch.Tensor,
+        temperature: torch.Tensor,
+        seeds: torch.Tensor,
+        dp_sync_state: DPSyncState | None = None,
+        dummy_run: bool = False,
+        skip_attn_for_dummy_run: bool = False,
+        mm_inputs: tuple[list[torch.Tensor], torch.Tensor] | None = None,
+        is_profile: bool = False,
+        num_speculative_tokens: int | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        batch = input_batch.num_reqs
+        query_width = self.num_query_per_req
+        count = batch * query_width
+        if count > self.max_num_tokens:
+            raise ValueError("DFly query block exceeds max_num_batched_tokens")
+        result = self.draft_tokens[:batch]
+        if batch == 0 or num_speculative_tokens == 0:
+            return result.fill_(-1)
+        assert self.reuse is not None
+        descriptor = BatchExecutionDescriptor(CUDAGraphMode.NONE, count, batch)
+        if not dummy_run and self.cudagraph_manager is not None:
+            descriptor = self.cudagraph_manager.dispatch(
+                batch, count, uniform_token_count=query_width, num_active_loras=0
+            )
+        padded_count = descriptor.num_tokens
+        assert padded_count % query_width == 0
+        padded_batch = padded_count // query_width
+        if not dummy_run and not self._storage_validated:
+            self.reuse.validate_storage()
+            self._storage_validated = True
+
+        with_attn = not (dummy_run and skip_attn_for_dummy_run)
+        if dummy_run:
+            inputs, num_reqs = self._dummy_propose_inputs(), 0
+        else:
+            inputs = DFlyProposeInputs(
+                query_start_loc=input_batch.query_start_loc,
+                positions=input_batch.positions,
+                idx_mapping=input_batch.idx_mapping,
+                num_sampled=num_sampled,
+                num_rejected=num_rejected,
+                last_sampled=last_sampled,
+                last_hidden_states=last_hidden_states,
+                temperature=temperature,
+                seeds=seeds,
+            )
+            num_reqs = batch
+        self._prepare_query(inputs, num_reqs, padded_batch, write_slots=with_attn)
+
+        metadata = None
+        draft_slots = None

+"""Flash coarse-only gated IndexPool with bounded paged FP8 scoring (ROCm)."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm import envs
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ReplicatedLinear
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv, next_power_of_2
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.rocm_aiter_mla_sparse import rocm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits
+
+from ..common.indexpool_cache import POOL_PAGE_SIZE, IndexPoolCache, IndexPoolMetadata
+from .indexpool_ops import (
+    INDEX_DIM,
+    expand_groups,
+    fwht_quantize,
+    gated_pool,
+    rope_inverse_frequencies,
+    rotate_indexer,
+    select_groups,
+    write_pool,
+)
+from .indexpool_prepare import prepare_groups, write_tails
+
+
+class FlashCompressedIndexer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, config, topk_indices_buffer, prefix):
+        super().__init__()
+        if current_platform.fp8_dtype() != torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Flash IndexPool requires OCP FP8 (gfx950)")
+        self.ratio = config.compressed_indexer_compress_ratio
+        self.group_budget = config.compressed_indexer_group_topk - 1
+        self.num_heads = config.compressed_indexer_num_attention_heads
+        if not 1 <= self.num_heads <= 64:
+            raise ValueError("IndexPool requires 1..64 scoring heads")
+        self.rope_dim = config.qk_rope_head_dim
+        self.rope_parameters = config.rope_parameters
+        self.register_buffer(
+            "rope_inverse",
+            rope_inverse_frequencies(self.rope_dim, self.rope_parameters)
+            if self.rope_dim
+            else None,
+            persistent=False,
+        )
+        self.eps = config.rms_norm_eps
+        self.topk_indices_buffer = topk_indices_buffer
+        self.max_model_len = vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len
+        self.logits_budget = envs.VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB * 1024 * 1024 // 4
+        for name, input_size, output_size in (
+            ("query_projection", config.q_lora_rank, self.num_heads * INDEX_DIM),
+            ("head_weight_projection", config.hidden_size, self.num_heads),
+            ("token_key_projection", config.hidden_size, INDEX_DIM),
+        ):
+            setattr(
+                self,
+                name,
+                ReplicatedLinear(
+                    input_size,
+                    output_size,
+                    bias=False,
+                    quant_config=vllm_config.quant_config,
+                    prefix=f"{prefix}.{name}",
+                ),
+            )
+        self.token_key_norm = nn.RMSNorm(INDEX_DIM, eps=self.eps)
+        self.key_value_projection = nn.Linear(
+            INDEX_DIM, INDEX_DIM, bias=False, dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+        self.key_gate_projection = nn.Linear(
+            INDEX_DIM, INDEX_DIM, bias=False, dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+        self.key_norm = nn.RMSNorm(INDEX_DIM, eps=self.eps, dtype=torch.float32)
+        self.intra_group_ape = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(self.ratio, INDEX_DIM, dtype=torch.float32)
+        )
+        self.k_cache = IndexPoolCache(
+            f"{prefix}.k_cache", vllm_config.cache_config, self.ratio
+        )
+        self.tail_cache = IndexPoolCache(
+            f"{prefix}.tail_cache",
+            vllm_config.cache_config,
+            self.ratio,
+            tail=True,
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, q_c, positions, rope=None):
+        output = self.topk_indices_buffer[: hidden_states.shape[0]]
+        output.fill_(-1)
+        metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        if metadata is None:
+            return output
+        if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
+            raise TypeError("IndexPool requires per-layer metadata")
+        km = metadata[self.k_cache.prefix]
+        tm = metadata[self.tail_cache.prefix]
+        if not isinstance(km, IndexPoolMetadata) or not isinstance(
+            tm, IndexPoolMetadata
+        ):
+            raise TypeError("IndexPool cache metadata has an incompatible type")
+        tokens = km.num_actual_tokens

+            return output
+        keys = self.token_key_norm(
+            self.token_key_projection(hidden_states)[0]
+        ).bfloat16()
+        cache, tail = self.k_cache.kv_cache, self.tail_cache.kv_cache
+        (
+            raw,
+            group_positions,
+            group_owner,
+            groups,
+            group_live,
+            owner,
+            logical,
+            upper,
+            live,
+        ) = prepare_groups(
+            keys,
+            positions,
+            tail,
+            tm.block_table,
+            km.query_start_loc,
+            km.seq_lens,
+            tokens,
+            self.ratio,
+        )
+        if raw.shape[0]:
+            values = self.key_value_projection(raw.float())
+            gates = self.key_gate_projection(raw.float())
+            pooled = gated_pool(
+                values, gates, self.intra_group_ape, self.key_norm.weight, self.eps
+            ).bfloat16()
+            quant, scales = fwht_quantize(
+                rotate_indexer(
+                    pooled,
+                    group_positions,
+                    self.rope_dim,
+                    self.rope_parameters,
+                    self.rope_inverse,
+                )
+            )
+            write_pool(
+                cache, km.block_table, group_owner, groups, group_live, quant, scales
+            )
+        write_tails(
+            keys, positions, tail, tm.block_table, km.query_start_loc, km.seq_lens
+        )
+        query = self.query_projection(q_c)[0][:tokens].reshape(
+            tokens, self.num_heads, INDEX_DIM
+        )
+        query = rotate_indexer(
+            query,
+            positions[..., :tokens],
+            self.rope_dim,
+            self.rope_parameters,
+            self.rope_inverse,
+        )
+        quant_q, scales_q = fwht_quantize(query.reshape(-1, INDEX_DIM).bfloat16())
+        # The Triton scorer needs a power-of-two head tile of at least 16.
+        heads = max(16, next_power_of_2(self.num_heads))
+        quant_q = quant_q.reshape(tokens, self.num_heads, INDEX_DIM)
+        weights = self.head_weight_projection(hidden_states)[0][:tokens].float()
+        weights = weights * (self.num_heads**-0.5 * INDEX_DIM**-0.5)
+        weights = weights * scales_q.reshape(tokens, self.num_heads)
+        if heads != self.num_heads:
+            quant_q = torch.cat(
+                (quant_q, quant_q.new_zeros(tokens, heads - self.num_heads, INDEX_DIM)),
+                1,
+            )
+            weights = torch.cat(
+                (weights, weights.new_zeros(tokens, heads - self.num_heads)), 1
+            )
+        quant_q = quant_q[:, None]
+        max_seq_len = (
+            self.max_model_len
+            if get_forward_context().cudagraph_runtime_mode == CUDAGraphMode.FULL
+            else km.max_seq_len
+        )
+        width = max(
+            POOL_PAGE_SIZE,
+            cdiv(max_seq_len, self.ratio * POOL_PAGE_SIZE) * POOL_PAGE_SIZE,
+        )
+        if self.logits_budget < width:
+            raise ValueError("IndexPool logits budget cannot hold a single scoring row")
+        chunk = max(1, self.logits_budget // width)
+        for begin in range(0, tokens, chunk):
+            end = min(tokens, begin + chunk)
+            bounds = upper[begin:end]
+            lengths = bounds.clamp_min(1).int()[:, None].contiguous()
+            table = km.block_table[owner[begin:end]].contiguous()
+            logits = rocm_fp8_paged_mqa_logits(
+                quant_q[begin:end].contiguous(),
+                cache.unsqueeze(2),
+                weights[begin:end].contiguous(),
+                lengths,
+                table,
+                None,
+                width,
+                cache_layout="NORMAL",
+            )
+            recalled = select_groups(logits, bounds, self.group_budget)
+            output[begin:end].copy_(
+                expand_groups(
+                    recalled,
+                    logical[begin:end],
+                    self.ratio,
+                    active=live[begin:end],
+                )
+            )
+        return output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Coarse IndexPool mathematics, independent of cache allocation."""
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.rotary_embedding.mrope import apply_interleaved_rope
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+INDEX_DIM = 128
+FP8_MAX = torch.finfo(torch.float8_e4m3fn).max
+
+
+def fwht_quantize(vectors: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    if vectors.ndim != 2 or vectors.shape[1] != INDEX_DIM:
+        raise ValueError("IndexPool quantization requires [rows, 128] vectors")
+    x = vectors.float()
+    stride = 1
+    while stride < INDEX_DIM:
+        pairs = x.reshape(-1, 2, stride)
+        left, right = pairs[:, 0], pairs[:, 1]
+        x = torch.stack((left + right, left - right), dim=1).reshape(vectors.shape)
+        stride *= 2
+    x = x * INDEX_DIM**-0.5
+    scale = torch.exp2(
+        torch.ceil(torch.log2(x.abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(1e-4) / FP8_MAX))
+    )
+    quant = (x / scale[:, None]).clamp(-FP8_MAX, FP8_MAX).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    return quant, scale
+
+
+def gated_pool(values, gates, ape, norm_weight, eps):
+    probabilities = (gates.float() + ape.float()).softmax(1)
+    pooled = (values.float() * probabilities).sum(1)
+    return F.rms_norm(pooled, (INDEX_DIM,), norm_weight.float(), eps)
+
+
+def rope_inverse_frequencies(rope_dim, parameters, device=None):
+    if parameters.get("rope_type", "default") != "default":
+        raise ValueError("Flash IndexPool currently requires default RoPE")
+    theta = parameters.get("rope_theta", 10000.0)
+    return theta ** (
+        -torch.arange(0, rope_dim, 2, device=device, dtype=torch.float32) / rope_dim
+    )
+
+
+def rotate_indexer(x, positions, rope_dim, parameters, inverse=None):
+    if rope_dim == 0:
+        return x
+    if inverse is None:
+        inverse = rope_inverse_frequencies(rope_dim, parameters, x.device)
+    if positions.ndim == 1:
+        frequency = positions.float()[:, None] * inverse
+    else:
+        section = parameters.get("mrope_section")
+        if positions.shape[0] != 3 or section is None or sum(section) * 2 != rope_dim:
+            raise ValueError("IndexPool requires valid three-axis MRoPE sections")
+        planes = positions.float()[:, :, None] * inverse
+        if parameters.get("mrope_interleaved", True):
+            frequency = apply_interleaved_rope(planes, section)
+        else:
+            parts, offset = [], 0
+            for axis, width in enumerate(section):
+                parts.append(planes[axis, :, offset : offset + width])
+                offset += width
+            frequency = torch.cat(parts, -1)
+    nope, pe = x.split((x.shape[-1] - rope_dim, rope_dim), dim=-1)
+    pe = (
+        pe.reshape(*pe.shape[:-1], rope_dim // 2, 2).transpose(-2, -1).reshape(pe.shape)
+    )
+    frequency = torch.cat((frequency, frequency), -1)
+    if pe.ndim == 3:
+        frequency = frequency[:, None]
+    left, right = pe.float().chunk(2, dim=-1)
+    rotated = (
+        pe.float() * frequency.cos() + torch.cat((-right, left), -1) * frequency.sin()
+    )
+    return torch.cat((nope, rotated.to(x.dtype)), dim=-1)
+
+
+def expand_groups(group_ids, positions, ratio, active=None):
+    offsets = torch.arange(ratio, device=group_ids.device)
+    upper = positions // ratio
+    live = positions >= 0
+    if active is not None:
+        live = live & active
+    history = group_ids[..., None] * ratio + offsets
+    valid = (group_ids >= 0) & (group_ids < upper[:, None]) & live[:, None]
+    history = torch.where(valid[..., None], history, -1)
+    tail = upper[:, None] * ratio + offsets
+    tail = torch.where(live[:, None] & (tail <= positions[:, None]), tail, -1)
+    candidates = torch.cat((history.flatten(1), tail), -1).int()
+    valid = candidates >= 0
+    destinations = torch.where(
+        valid,
+        valid.long().cumsum(-1) - 1,
+        valid.sum(-1, keepdim=True) + (~valid).long().cumsum(-1) - 1,
+    )
+    return torch.empty_like(candidates).scatter(-1, destinations, candidates)
+
+
+def select_groups(logits, upper, budget):
+    columns = torch.arange(logits.shape[1], device=logits.device)
+    scores = logits.masked_fill(columns[None] >= upper[:, None], -torch.inf)
+    count = min(budget, logits.shape[1])
+    values, indices = scores.topk(count, dim=-1)
+    sentinel = torch.iinfo(torch.int32).max
+    indices = torch.where(values != -torch.inf, indices, sentinel).int()
+    indices = indices.sort(dim=-1).values
+    indices.masked_fill_(indices == sentinel, -1)
+    return F.pad(indices, (0, budget - count), value=-1)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _scatter_rows(
+    Dst,
+    Src,
+    Offsets,
+    SRC_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    offset = tl.load(Offsets + row)
+    if offset >= 0:
+        columns = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+        value = tl.load(Src + row * SRC_STRIDE + columns, columns < WIDTH, 0)
+        tl.store(Dst + offset + columns, value, columns < WIDTH)
+
+
+def write_pool(cache, table, owners, groups, active, quant, scales):
+    if groups.numel() == 0:
+        return
+    page_size = cache.shape[1]
+    columns = (groups // page_size).clamp(0, table.shape[1] - 1)
+    base = table[owners, columns].long() * cache.stride(0)
+    row = groups % page_size
+    _scatter_rows[(groups.numel(),)](
+        cache,
+        quant.view(torch.uint8),
+        torch.where(active, base + row * INDEX_DIM, -1),
+        quant.stride(0),
+        INDEX_DIM,
+        INDEX_DIM,
+    )
+    _scatter_rows[(groups.numel(),)](
+        cache,
+        scales.contiguous().view(torch.uint8),
+        torch.where(active, base + page_size * INDEX_DIM + row * 4, -1),
+        4,
+        4,
+        4,
+    )

+"""Read committed carry before retaining new speculative IndexPool keys."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+# Batch, token and slot counts change every step, so they stay runtime
+# arguments instead of triggering a recompile per value.
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["BATCH"])
+def _group_prefix(Starts, Lengths, Ends, BATCH, R: tl.constexpr, BLOCK: tl.constexpr):
+    request = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    start = tl.load(Starts + request, request < BATCH, 0)
+    end = tl.load(Starts + request + 1, request < BATCH, 0)
+    length = tl.load(Lengths + request, request < BATCH, 0)
+    context = length - (end - start)
+    live = (request < BATCH) & (end > start) & (context >= 0)
+    count = tl.where(live, length // R - tl.maximum(context, 0) // R, 0)
+    tl.store(Ends + request, tl.cumsum(count), request < BATCH)
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["BATCH", "TOKENS", "SLOTS", "POS_PLANE"])
+def _gather_groups(
+    Keys,
+    Positions,
+    Tail,
+    Table,
+    Starts,
+    Lengths,
+    Ends,
+    Raw,
+    XYZ,
+    Requests,
+    Groups,
+    Live,
+    BATCH,
+    TOKENS,
+    SLOTS,
+    R: tl.constexpr,
+    RING: tl.constexpr,
+    KEY_ROW: tl.constexpr,
+    KEY_COL: tl.constexpr,
+    POS_PLANE,
+    POS_TOKEN: tl.constexpr,
+    THREE: tl.constexpr,
+    TAIL_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    TAIL_ROW: tl.constexpr,
+    TABLE_ROW: tl.constexpr,
+):

+        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
+        end_count = tl.load(Ends + mid, mid < BATCH, 2147483647)

+        hi = tl.where(left, mid, hi)

+    first = group * R

+    )
+    tl.store(
+        Raw + slot * R * 128 + tl.arange(0, R)[:, None] * 128 + channel[None, :],
+        tl.where(old[:, None], retained, current),
+    )
+    axis = tl.arange(0, 4)
+    retained_xyz = tl.load(
+        Tail + block * TAIL_BLOCK + (first % RING) * TAIL_ROW + 128 + axis,
+        live & (first < context) & (axis < 3),
+        0,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+    source_first = start + first - context
+    if THREE:
+        position = tl.load(
+            Positions + axis * POS_PLANE + source_first * POS_TOKEN,
+            live & (first >= context) & (axis < 3),
+            0,
+        ).to(tl.int64)
+    else:
+        position = tl.load(
+            Positions + source_first * POS_TOKEN,
+            live & (first >= context),
+            0,
+        ).to(tl.int64)
+    coordinates = tl.where(first < context, retained_xyz, position)
+    tl.store(XYZ + axis * SLOTS + slot, tl.where(live, coordinates, 0), axis < 3)
+    tl.store(Requests + slot, request)
+    tl.store(Groups + slot, group)
+    tl.store(Live + slot, live)
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["BATCH", "TOKENS"])
+def _query_metadata(
+    Starts,
+    Lengths,
+    Owner,
+    Logical,
+    Upper,
+    Live,
+    BATCH,
+    TOKENS,
+    SEARCH_STEPS: tl.constexpr,
+    R: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    lo = tl.full((BLOCK,), 0, tl.int32)
+    hi = tl.full((BLOCK,), BATCH, tl.int32)
+    for _ in range(SEARCH_STEPS):
+        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
+        end = tl.load(Starts + mid + 1, mid < BATCH, 2147483647)
+        left = token < end
+        hi = tl.where(left, mid, hi)
+        lo = tl.where(left, lo, mid + 1)
+    request = tl.minimum(lo, BATCH - 1)
+    start = tl.load(Starts + request)
+    end = tl.load(Starts + request + 1)
+    length = tl.load(Lengths + request)
+    context = length - (end - start)
+    live = (lo < BATCH) & (end > start) & (context >= 0)
+    logical = tl.maximum(context, 0).to(tl.int64) + token - start
+    tl.store(Owner + token, request, token < TOKENS)
+    tl.store(Logical + token, logical, token < TOKENS)
+    tl.store(Upper + token, tl.where(live, logical // R, 0), token < TOKENS)
+    tl.store(Live + token, live, token < TOKENS)
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["POS_PLANE"])
+def _write_tails(
+    Keys,
+    Positions,
+    Tail,
+    Table,
+    Starts,
+    Lengths,
+    RING: tl.constexpr,
+    KEY_ROW: tl.constexpr,
+    KEY_COL: tl.constexpr,
+    POS_PLANE,
+    POS_TOKEN: tl.constexpr,
+    THREE: tl.constexpr,
+    TAIL_BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    TAIL_ROW: tl.constexpr,
+    TABLE_ROW: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    request, offset = tl.program_id(0), tl.program_id(1)
+    start = tl.load(Starts + request)
+    end = tl.load(Starts + request + 1)
+    length = tl.load(Lengths + request)
+    context = length - (end - start)
+    token = length - RING + offset
+    live = (end > start) & (context >= 0) & (token >= context)
+    source = start + token - context
+    block = tl.load(Table + request * TABLE_ROW, live, 0).to(tl.int64)
+    channel = tl.arange(0, 256)
+    key = tl.load(
+        Keys + source * KEY_ROW + channel * KEY_COL,
+        live & (channel < 128),
+        0,
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    if THREE:
+        axis = tl.maximum(channel - 128, 0)
+        position = tl.load(
+            Positions + axis * POS_PLANE + source * POS_TOKEN,
+            live & (channel >= 128) & (channel < 131),
+            0,
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+    else:
+        position = tl.load(Positions + source * POS_TOKEN, live, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(
+        Tail + block * TAIL_BLOCK + (token % RING) * TAIL_ROW + channel,
+        tl.where(channel < 128, key, position),
+        live & (channel < 131),
+    )
+
+
+def prepare_groups(keys, positions, tail, table, starts, lengths, tokens, ratio):
+    batch, device = lengths.numel(), keys.device
+    slots = (tokens + batch * (ratio - 1)) // ratio
+    prefix = torch.empty(batch, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    raw = torch.empty((slots, ratio, 128), dtype=keys.dtype, device=device)
+    coordinates = torch.empty((3, slots), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    requests = torch.empty(slots, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    groups = torch.empty(slots, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    group_live = torch.empty(slots, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+    owner = torch.empty(tokens, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    logical = torch.empty(tokens, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    upper = torch.empty(tokens, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    token_live = torch.empty(tokens, dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+    if batch:
+        _group_prefix[(1,)](
+            starts, lengths, prefix, batch, ratio, triton.next_power_of_2(batch)
+        )
+    if slots:
+        _gather_groups[(slots,)](
+            keys,
+            positions,
+            tail,
+            table,
+            starts,
+            lengths,
+            prefix,
+            raw,
+            coordinates,
+            requests,
+            groups,
+            group_live,
+            batch,
+            tokens,
+            slots,
+            ratio,
+            tail.shape[1],
+            keys.stride(0),
+            keys.stride(1),
+            positions.stride(0) if positions.ndim == 2 else 0,
+            positions.stride(-1),
+            positions.ndim == 2,
+            tail.stride(0),
+            tail.stride(1),
+            table.stride(0),
+        )
+    if tokens:
+        _query_metadata[(triton.cdiv(tokens, 256),)](
+            starts,
+            lengths,
+            owner,
+            logical,
+            upper,
+            token_live,
+            batch,
+            tokens,
+            (batch + 1).bit_length(),
+            ratio,
+            256,
+        )
+    group_positions = coordinates if positions.ndim == 2 else coordinates[0]
+    return (
+        raw,
+        group_positions,
+        requests,
+        groups,
+        group_live,
+        owner,
+        logical,
+        upper,
+        token_live,
+    )
+
+
+def write_tails(keys, positions, tail, table, starts, lengths):
+    if lengths.numel():
+        _write_tails[(lengths.numel(), tail.shape[1])](
+            keys,
+            positions,
+            tail,
+            table,
+            starts,
+            lengths,
+            tail.shape[1],
+            keys.stride(0),
+            keys.stride(1),
+            positions.stride(0) if positions.ndim == 2 else 0,
+            positions.stride(-1),
+            positions.ndim == 2,
+            tail.stride(0),
+            tail.stride(1),
+            table.stride(0),
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""HYV4 Flash backbone using the public HYV4 checkpoint contract (ROCm)."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import WeightsMapper
+from vllm.models.hy_v4.amd.hc import HYV4HCLayer
+from vllm.models.hy_v4.amd.model import (
+    HYV4DecoderLayer,
+    HYV4ForCausalLM,
+    HYV4Model,
+)
+from vllm.models.hy_v4.weight_utils import HYV4_MLP_MAPPER
+from vllm.models.hy_v4_flash.common.model import (
+    HYV4FlashForCausalLMMixin,
+    HYV4FlashModelMixin,
+)
+from vllm.models.hy_v4_flash.configs import HYV4FlashConfig
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
+
+from .attention import HYV4FlashAttention
+from .moe import HYV4FlashFeedForward, HYV4FlashMoE
+
+
+def validate_platform() -> None:
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        raise NotImplementedError("The HYV4 Flash AMD implementation requires ROCm")
+
+
+class HYV4FlashDecoderLayer(HYV4DecoderLayer):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: HYV4FlashConfig,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        cache_config=None,
+        quant_config=None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        topk_indices_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        ihc_sequence_parallel: bool = False,
+    ) -> None:
+        nn.Module.__init__(self)
+        self.config = config
+        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        self.layer_idx = int(prefix.rsplit(".", 1)[1])
+        self.enable_ihc = config.enable_ihc
+        assert not ihc_sequence_parallel
+        self.defer_reduction = False
+        self.self_attn = HYV4FlashAttention(
+            vllm_config,
+            config,
+            self.layer_idx,
+            topk_indices_buffer,
+            f"{prefix}.self_attn",
+        )
+        self.input_layernorm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, config.rms_norm_eps)
+        dense = (config.mlp_layer_types or ())[self.layer_idx] == "dense"
+        mlp_cls = HYV4FlashFeedForward if dense else HYV4FlashMoE
+        self.mlp = mlp_cls(config, quant_config, f"{prefix}.mlp")
+        self.block_type = "feedforward" if dense else "moe"
+        self.hc_attn_layer = HYV4HCLayer(
+            config, self.layer_idx, prefix=f"{prefix}.hc_attn_layer"
+        )
+        self.hc_mlp_layer = HYV4HCLayer(
+            config, self.layer_idx, prefix=f"{prefix}.hc_mlp_layer"
+        )
+
+
+class HYV4FlashModel(HYV4FlashModelMixin, HYV4Model):
+    decoder_layer_cls = HYV4FlashDecoderLayer
+    supports_ihc_sequence_parallel = False
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__(vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=prefix)
+        self.init_engram(vllm_config, prefix)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        lookback_token_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.engram_hash is None:
+            return super().forward(
+                input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors, inputs_embeds
+            )
+        if input_ids is None:
+            raise ValueError("Flash Engram requires original input token IDs")
+        hidden = (
+            inputs_embeds
+            if inputs_embeds is not None
+            else self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        )
+        hashes = input_ids.new_empty(
+            (
+                len(self.config.engram_layer_ids),
+                input_ids.numel(),
+                self.engram_hash.offsets.shape[1],
+            ),
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+        )
+        self.engram_hash.prepare_hashes_with_output(
+            input_ids,
+            lookback_token_ids,
+            self.layers[0].self_attn.mla_attn.layer_name,
+            hashes,
+        )
+        hash_indices = {
+            layer_id - 1: index
+            for index, layer_id in enumerate(self.config.engram_layer_ids)
+        }
+        for index, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            if index in hash_indices:
+                hidden = layer.hc_attn_layer.prepare_input(hidden)
+                hidden = layer.engram_layer(hidden, hashes[hash_indices[index]])
+            hidden, _ = layer(positions, hidden, None)
+        return self.norm(self.hc_head(hidden))
+
+
+class HYV4FlashForCausalLM(HYV4FlashForCausalLMMixin, HYV4ForCausalLM):
+    model_cls = HYV4FlashModel
+    supports_lora = False  # type: ignore[assignment]
+    supports_pp = False  # type: ignore[assignment]
+    requires_raw_input_tokens = True
+    packed_modules_mapping = {"gate_up_proj": ["gate_proj", "up_proj"]}
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = HYV4_MLP_MAPPER | WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_substr={".compressed_indexer.": ".indexer."},
+    )
+
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        validate_platform()
+        super().__init__(vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=prefix)
+        self.init_weight_loading(vllm_config)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Flash latent experts with HYV4's routing, shared experts and weight format."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ReplicatedLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization import QuantizationConfig
+from vllm.models.hy_v4.nvidia.moe import HYV4FeedForward, HYV4MoEFused
+from vllm.models.hy_v4_flash.configs import HYV4FlashConfig
+
+
+class HYV4FlashFeedForward(HYV4FeedForward):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: HYV4FlashConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(
+            config.hidden_size,
+            config.intermediate_size,
+            config.hidden_act,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=prefix,
+        )
+        self.post_fc2_norm = (
+            RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+            if config.sandwich_norm
+            else None
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        result = super().forward(x)
+        return self.post_fc2_norm(result) if self.post_fc2_norm is not None else result
+
+
+class HYV4FlashMoE(HYV4MoEFused):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: HYV4FlashConfig,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        latent = config.routed_expert_hidden_size
+        down: nn.Module | None = None
+        up: nn.Module | None = None
+        if latent is not None:
+            down = ReplicatedLinear(
+                config.hidden_size,
+                latent,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.routed_expert_down_proj",
+            )
+            up = ReplicatedLinear(
+                latent,
+                config.hidden_size,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.routed_expert_up_proj",
+            )
+        super().__init__(
+            config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=prefix,
+            routed_hidden_size=latent,
+            routed_input_transform=down,
+            routed_output_transform=up,
+        )
+        self.routed_expert_down_proj = down
+        self.routed_expert_up_proj = up
+        self.combine_output_norm = (
+            RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+            if config.sandwich_norm
+            else None
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        result = super().forward(hidden_states)
+        return (
+            self.combine_output_norm(result)
+            if self.combine_output_norm is not None
+            else result
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""ROCm sparse MLA backends and causal window indexing for HYV4 Flash.
+
+The AITER sparse path reads each row's first `paged_kv_indptr` delta entries
+and maps an invalid index to slot 0 rather than skipping it, so every indexer
+must pack its live indices to the front of the row, and the builder must count
+exactly the live entries of each row.
+"""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import round_up
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import AttentionCGSupport
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.rocm_aiter_mla_sparse import (
+    ROCMAiterMLASparseBackend,
+    ROCMAiterMLASparseMetadataBuilder,
+)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _live_counts_kernel(
+    seq_lens_ptr,
+    query_start_loc_ptr,
+    out_ptr,
+    WINDOW: tl.constexpr,
+    RATIO: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP_BUDGET: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    request = tl.program_id(0)
+    offsets = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    start = tl.load(query_start_loc_ptr + request)
+    end = tl.load(query_start_loc_ptr + request + 1)
+    mask = start + offsets < end
+    seq_len = tl.load(seq_lens_ptr + request)
+    logical = seq_len - (end - start) + offsets
+    if WINDOW > 0:
+        count = tl.minimum(logical + 1, WINDOW)
+    else:
+        groups = tl.minimum(logical // RATIO, GROUP_BUDGET)
+        count = groups * RATIO + logical % RATIO + 1
+    count = tl.where((seq_len > 0) & (logical >= 0), count, 0)
+    tl.store(out_ptr + start + offsets, count, mask=mask)
+
+
+def live_counts(
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+    num_tokens: int,
+    max_query_len: int,
+    window: int,
+    ratio: int,
+    group_budget: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Live top-k entries per query token, given its logical position.
+
+    A window row holds `min(pos + 1, window)` entries. A compressed row holds
+    up to `group_budget` whole history groups plus the `pos % ratio + 1`
+    tokens of its open group, which is `pos + 1` until the budget saturates.
+    """
+    out = torch.zeros(num_tokens, dtype=torch.int32, device=seq_lens.device)
+    num_reqs = query_start_loc.numel() - 1
+    if num_tokens == 0 or num_reqs == 0:
+        return out
+    block = 64
+    _live_counts_kernel[(num_reqs, triton.cdiv(max_query_len, block))](
+        seq_lens,
+        query_start_loc,
+        out,
+        WINDOW=window,
+        RATIO=ratio,
+        GROUP_BUDGET=group_budget,
+        BLOCK=block,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+class FlashSparseMetadataBuilder(ROCMAiterMLASparseMetadataBuilder):
+    _cudagraph_support = AttentionCGSupport.UNIFORM_BATCH
+
+    def __init__(self, kv_cache_spec, layer_names, vllm_config, device):
+        super().__init__(kv_cache_spec, layer_names, vllm_config, device)
+        layer = vllm_config.compilation_config.static_forward_context[layer_names[0]]
+        assert layer.topk_buffer_width is not None
+        self.topk_tokens = layer.topk_buffer_width
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+        sliding = getattr(layer, "sliding_window", None)
+        self.window = int(sliding) if sliding else 0
+        self.ratio = config.compressed_indexer_compress_ratio
+        self.group_budget = config.compressed_indexer_group_topk - 1
+        if self.window:
+            assert self.window <= self.topk_tokens
+        else:
+            assert (self.group_budget + 1) * self.ratio <= self.topk_tokens
+
+    def build(self, common_prefix_len, common_attn_metadata, fast_build=False):
+        metadata = super().build(
+            common_prefix_len, common_attn_metadata, fast_build=fast_build
+        )
+        cm = common_attn_metadata
+        num_reqs = metadata.num_reqs
+        num_tokens = int(cm.query_start_loc_cpu[num_reqs].item())
+        counts = live_counts(
+            cm.seq_lens[:num_reqs],
+            cm.query_start_loc[: num_reqs + 1],
+            num_tokens,
+            cm.max_query_len,
+            self.window,
+            self.ratio,
+            self.group_budget,
+        )
+        torch.cumsum(counts, dim=0, out=self.paged_kv_indptr[1 : num_tokens + 1])
+        tail = self.paged_kv_indptr[num_tokens + 1 :]
+        tail.copy_(self.paged_kv_indptr[num_tokens].expand_as(tail))
+        return metadata
+
+
+class FlashSparseBackend(ROCMAiterMLASparseBackend):
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_builder_cls():
+        return FlashSparseMetadataBuilder
+
+    @classmethod
+    def supports_pcp(cls):
+        return False
+
+    @classmethod
+    def supports_dcp(cls):
+        return False
+
+
+class FlashSWABackend(FlashSparseBackend):
+    @classmethod
+    def supports_sliding_window(cls):
+        return True
+
+
+def window_indices(positions: torch.Tensor, window: int, width: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Causal window indices packed to the front of each row."""
+    if window < 1 or width < window:
+        raise ValueError("SWA index width must cover its causal window")
+    columns = torch.arange(width, device=positions.device)
+    first = (positions - window + 1).clamp_min(0)
+    count = (positions + 1).clamp(0, window)
+    indices = first[:, None] + columns
+    live = (positions[:, None] >= 0) & (columns < count[:, None])
+    return torch.where(live, indices, -1).int()
+
+
+class FlashWindowIndexer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, window: int, topk_indices_buffer, attention_prefix: str):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.window = window
+        self.attention_prefix = attention_prefix
+        # Logical-to-physical remapping uses 128-column tiles.
+        width = round_up(window, 128)
+        if window < 1 or topk_indices_buffer.shape[1] < width:
+            raise ValueError("SWA index width must cover its causal window")
+        rows = topk_indices_buffer.shape[0]
+        # Reuse the shared scratch storage with a packed, window-sized stride.
+        self.topk_indices_buffer = topk_indices_buffer.view(-1)[: rows * width].view(
+            rows, width
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states, q_c, positions, rope=None):
+        output = self.topk_indices_buffer[: hidden_states.shape[0]]
+        metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        if metadata is None:
+            return output.fill_(-1)
+        if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
+            raise TypeError("Flash SWA requires per-layer metadata")
+        meta: Any = metadata[self.attention_prefix]
+        if meta.num_actual_tokens == 0 or meta.seq_lens.numel() == 0:
+            return output.fill_(-1)
+        rows = torch.arange(output.shape[0], device=output.device)
+        starts = meta.query_start_loc
+        requests = torch.searchsorted(starts[1:], rows, right=True)
+        requests = requests.clamp_max(starts.numel() - 2).long()

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Vendor-neutral HYV4 Flash Engram setup and checkpoint loading."""
+
+from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from typing import Any
+
+import regex as re
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.default_loader import DefaultModelLoader
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import default_weight_loader
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import AutoWeightsLoader, WeightsMapper
+from vllm.models.hy_v4.weight_utils import HYV4_WEIGHTS_MAPPER
+
+from .engram import FlashEngram, FlashNgramHashState
+
+_EXPERT_WEIGHT = re.compile(
+    r"(.*)\.experts\.(?:(\d+)\.)?(gate_proj|up_proj|down_proj|gate_up_proj)"
+    r"(\.weight(?:_packed|_scale(?:_inv)?)?|_scale(?:_inv)?)?"
+)
+
+
+class HYV4FlashModelMixin(nn.Module):
+    """Engram layers and audited checkpoint loading for `HYV4FlashModel`.
+
+    Listed before the vendor `HYV4Model` base, which provides `config`,
+    `layers` and `get_expert_mapping`.
+    """
+
+    config: Any
+    layers: Any
+    get_expert_mapping: Callable[[], list[tuple[str, str, int, str]]]
+
+    def init_engram(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str) -> None:
+        self.loaded_parts: dict[str, set[Any]] = {}
+        self.engram_hash: FlashNgramHashState | None = None
+        if self.config.engram_layer_ids:
+            self.engram_hash = FlashNgramHashState(
+                self.config, dummy=vllm_config.load_config.load_format == "dummy"
+            )
+            for layer_id in self.config.engram_layer_ids:
+                self.layers[layer_id - 1].engram_layer = FlashEngram(
+                    vllm_config,
+                    self.engram_hash.layout,
+                    layer_id,
+                    f"{prefix}.layers.{layer_id - 1}.engram_layer",
+                )
+        self.token_lookback_depth = (
+            self.config.engram_max_ngram_size - 1 if self.engram_hash is not None else 0
+        )
+
+    def _record_part(self, name: str, part: Any) -> None:
+        parts = self.loaded_parts.setdefault(name, set())
+        if part in parts or (None in parts) or (part is None and parts):
+            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate Flash checkpoint weight or shard: {name}")
+        parts.add(part)
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        parameters = dict(self.named_parameters())
+        expert_mapping = {
+            weight_name: (param_name, expert_id, shard)
+            for param_name, weight_name, expert_id, shard in self.get_expert_mapping()
+        }
+        loaded: set[str] = set()
+        for name, value in HYV4_WEIGHTS_MAPPER.apply(weights):
+            engram = re.fullmatch(r"layers\.(\d+)\.engram_layer\.(.+)", name)
+            if engram is not None:
+                assert self.engram_hash is not None
+                layer, leaf = engram.groups()
+                if int(layer) + 1 not in (self.config.engram_layer_ids or ()):
+                    raise ValueError(f"Undeclared Engram checkpoint weight: {name}")
+                if leaf == "lookup_table":
+                    self._record_part(name, None)
+                    self.engram_hash.load_lookup(value)
+                    continue
+                filled = self.layers[int(layer)].engram_layer.load_weight(leaf, value)
+                if filled is not None:
+                    local_name, part = filled
+                    target = f"layers.{layer}.engram_layer.{local_name}"
+                    self._record_part(target, part)
+                    loaded.add(target)
+                continue
+            expert = _EXPERT_WEIGHT.fullmatch(name)
+            if expert:
+                prefix, expert_id, projection, suffix = expert.groups()
+                projections = (
+                    ("gate_proj", "up_proj")
+                    if projection == "gate_up_proj"
+                    else (projection,)
+                )
+                suffix = (suffix or "").removeprefix(".weight")
+                if expert_id is None:
+                    if value.ndim != 3 or value.shape[0] != self.config.num_experts:
+                        raise ValueError(
+                            f"Invalid packed expert shape for {name}: {value.shape}"
+                        )
+                    expert_ids = list(range(self.config.num_experts))
+                else:
+                    expert_ids = [int(expert_id)]
+                for index in expert_ids:
+                    if not 0 <= index < self.config.num_experts:
+                        raise ValueError(f"Expert index out of range: {name}")
+                    tensor = value[index] if expert_id is None else value
+                    pieces = tensor.chunk(len(projections), dim=-2)
+                    for projection, piece in zip(projections, pieces):
+                        param_name, mapped_expert, shard = expert_mapping[
+                            f"experts.{index}.{projection}."
+                        ]
+                        target = f"{prefix}.{param_name}weight{suffix}"
+                        if target not in parameters:
+                            raise ValueError(f"Unknown Flash expert weight: {name}")
+                        parameter = parameters[target]
+                        success = parameter.weight_loader(
+                            parameter,
+                            piece,
+                            target,
+                            shard_id=shard,
+                            expert_id=mapped_expert,
+                            return_success=True,
+                        )
+                        if success:
+                            self._record_part(target, (mapped_expert, shard))
+                            loaded.add(target)
+                continue
+            if name not in parameters:
+                raise ValueError(f"Unknown Flash checkpoint weight: {name}")
+            parameter = parameters[name]
+            weight_shard = getattr(value, "shard_id", None)
+            self._record_part(name, weight_shard)
+            loader: Any = getattr(parameter, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)
+            if weight_shard is None:
+                loader(parameter, value)
+            else:
+                loader(parameter, value, weight_shard)
+            loaded.add(name)
+        return loaded
+
+    def verify_loaded_parts(self) -> None:
+        for layer_id in self.config.engram_layer_ids or ():
+            prefix = f"layers.{layer_id - 1}.engram_layer."
+            required = {
+                prefix + "lookup_table",
+                prefix + "multi_head_embedding.embedding.weight",
+            }
+            embedding = self.layers[layer_id - 1].engram_layer.multi_head_embedding
+            if embedding.fp8:
+                required.add(prefix + "multi_head_embedding.embedding.weight_scale_inv")
+            missing = required - self.loaded_parts.keys()
+            if missing:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Missing Engram checkpoint weights: {sorted(missing)}"
+                )
+        for name, parts in self.loaded_parts.items():
+            if None in parts:
+                continue
+            module_name, _, leaf = name.rpartition(".")
+            module = self.get_submodule(module_name)
+            expected: set[Any]
+            if leaf.startswith(("w13_weight", "w2_weight")):
+                expert_map = module.expert_map_manager.expert_map
+                local_ids = (
+                    range(self.config.num_experts)
+                    if expert_map is None
+                    else (expert_map >= 0).nonzero().flatten().tolist()
+                )
+                shards = ("w1", "w3") if leaf.startswith("w13_") else ("w2",)
+                expected = {(i, s) for i in local_ids for s in shards}
+            elif hasattr(module, "output_sizes"):
+                expected = set(range(len(module.output_sizes)))
+            else:
+                # Engram stacks one checkpoint tensor per parameter row.
+                expected = set(range(getattr(module, leaf).shape[0]))
+            if parts != expected:
+                raise ValueError(f"Incomplete Flash checkpoint shards: {name}")
+
+
+class HYV4FlashForCausalLMMixin(nn.Module):
+    """Audited weight loading and V2 model state for `HYV4FlashForCausalLM`.
+
+    Listed before the vendor `HYV4ForCausalLM` base.
+    """
+
+    config: Any
+    model: HYV4FlashModelMixin
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper: WeightsMapper
+
+    def init_weight_loading(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+        self.token_lookback_depth = self.model.token_lookback_depth
+        self._weight_loading_depth = 0
+        self._seen_weights: set[str] = set()
+        self._loaded_weights: set[str] = set()
+        self._load_config = vllm_config.load_config
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_model_state_cls():
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v41.nvidia.model_state import DeepseekV41ModelState
+
+        return DeepseekV41ModelState
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids,
+        positions,
+        intermediate_tensors=None,
+        inputs_embeds=None,
+        lookback_token_ids=None,
+    ):
+        return self.model(
+            input_ids,
+            positions,
+            intermediate_tensors,
+            inputs_embeds,
+            lookback_token_ids,
+        )
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def weight_loading_session(self):
+        """Audit the complete stream, including interleaved VL tower weights."""
+        outermost = self._weight_loading_depth == 0
+        if outermost:
+            self.model.loaded_parts.clear()
+            self._seen_weights.clear()
+            self._loaded_weights.clear()
+        self._weight_loading_depth += 1
+        try:
+            yield
+            if outermost:
+                required = {
+                    name
+                    for name, _ in self.named_parameters()
+                    if name.endswith((".weight", ".w13_weight", ".w2_weight"))
+                }
+                missing = required - self._loaded_weights
+                if missing:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"Missing Flash checkpoint weights: {sorted(missing)}"
+                    )
+                DefaultModelLoader(self._load_config).track_weights_loading(
+                    self, self._loaded_weights.copy(), quantized=True
+                )
+                self.model.verify_loaded_parts()
+        finally:
+            self._weight_loading_depth -= 1
+            if outermost:
+                self._seen_weights.clear()
+                self._loaded_weights.clear()
+
+    def _target_weights(self, weights):
+        for name, value in weights:
+            if name in self._seen_weights:
+                raise ValueError(f"Duplicate Flash checkpoint weight: {name}")
+            self._seen_weights.add(name)
+            engram = re.fullmatch(
+                r"model\.layers\.(\d+)\.(engram|engram_layer)\.(.+)", name
+            )
+            if engram is not None:
+                layer_number, prefix, leaf = engram.groups()
+                layer_id = int(layer_number) + (prefix == "engram_layer")
+                if layer_id not in (self.config.engram_layer_ids or ()):
+                    raise ValueError(f"Undeclared Engram checkpoint weight: {name}")
+                name = f"model.layers.{layer_id - 1}.engram_layer.{leaf}"
+            skip = False
+            if name.startswith("model.layers."):
+                layer = name.removeprefix("model.layers.").split(".", 1)[0]
+                first = self.config.num_hidden_layers
+                if layer.isdigit() and first <= int(layer) < (
+                    first + self.config.num_nextn_predict_layers
+                ):
+                    continue
+            for prefix, count in (
+                ("model.mtp_layers.", self.config.num_nextn_predict_layers),
+                (
+                    "model.dfly_layers.",
+                    getattr(self.config, "dfly_num_hidden_layers", 0),
+                ),
+            ):
+                if name.startswith(prefix):
+                    local = name[len(prefix) :]
+                    layer = local.removeprefix("layers.").split(".", 1)[0]
+                    declared = count > 0 and layer.isdigit() and 0 <= int(layer) < count
+                    if prefix == "model.dfly_layers." and count > 0:
+                        declared |= local.startswith(
+                            (
+                                "mtp_fusion.",
+                                "hidden_correction.",
+                                "final_norm.",
+                                "norm.",
+                                "embed_tokens.",
+                                "confidence_head.",
+                            )
+                        )
+                    if not declared:
+                        raise ValueError(f"Undeclared auxiliary Flash weight: {name}")
+                    skip = True
+                    break
+            if not skip:
+                yield name, value
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        with self.weight_loading_session():
+            loaded = AutoWeightsLoader(self).load_weights(
+                self._target_weights(weights), mapper=self.hf_to_vllm_mapper
+            )
+            self._loaded_weights.update(loaded)
+            return loaded

 `--prefix-match-unit` is required. It sets the granularity at which prefix-cache keys are computed. When unset it defaults to the greatest common divisor of the prefix-cacheable KV cache group block sizes. For hybrid Mamba models that is the block size itself, so no sub-block boundary exists and the flag has no effect.

Read the served block size from the startup log. 64 is a reasonable starting point.
+Choose a value that divides the block size of every prefix-cacheable KV cache group, matches the block size of any group that requires block-aligned lookups (such as sliding-window attention), and is a multiple of the per-state compression ratio for models that use one, such as sparse MLA. vLLM validates these at startup and fails if an explicit value would disable partial cache hits. -# This change monkeypatches get_graph_partition_signature in pytorch 2.9.0 to

-def get_graph_partition_signature_patched(
-    self, partitions, skip_cudagraphs: list[bool]
-):
-    """Gets signature for each graph partition, including input nodes, output nodes, and
-    whether deallocating an input within graph partition.
-    """
-    from torch._inductor import dependencies
-    from torch._inductor.ir import GraphPartitionSignature, MutationOutput, NoneLayout
-    from torch._inductor.virtualized import V
-    from torch.utils._ordered_set import OrderedSet
-
-    signatures = []
-
-    unmet_output_names = OrderedSet(V.graph.get_output_names())
-    name_to_node = self.get_name_to_nodes()
-
-    def is_none_layout(buf_name: str) -> bool:
-        """Checks if buf_name is NoneLayout. Buffers with NoneLayout is not allocated
-        so graph partition should not take it as inputs or outputs.
-        """
-        buf = self.name_to_buf.get(buf_name, None)
-
-        if buf is None:
-            return False
-
-        if isinstance(buf.node.layout, NoneLayout):
-            if isinstance(buf.node, MutationOutput) and (
-                real_name := self.mutation_real_name.get(buf_name, None)
-            ):
-                return is_none_layout(real_name)
-
-            return True
-
-        return False
-
-    for partition, skip_cudagraph in zip(
-        reversed(partitions), reversed(skip_cudagraphs)
-    ):
-        output_names: OrderedSet[str] = OrderedSet()
-
-        for node in partition:
-            output_names.update(node.outputs_by_name.keys())
-
-        returned_output_names = output_names.intersection(unmet_output_names)
-
-        # all reads/writes are partition inputs except those generated
-        # within the partition and tensor constants
-        read_writes = dependencies.ReadWrites.merge_list(
-            [node.read_writes for node in partition]
-        )
-
-        # WeakDep is fake dependency on unused buffer. It should not appear
-        # in partition_input_names for inputs that are actually read or written.
-        partition_input_names = (
-            OrderedSet(
-                [
-                    x.name
-                    for x in read_writes.reads | read_writes.writes
-                    if not is_none_layout(x.name)
-                ]
-            )
-            - output_names
-        )
-
-        partition_input_names = OrderedSet(
-            self.mutation_real_name.get(name, name) for name in partition_input_names
-        )
-
-        buffer_names_to_free: OrderedSet[str] = OrderedSet()
-        for node in partition:
-            buffer_names_to_free.update(node.last_usage)
-
-        # buffer_names_to_free may contain buffers allocated in previous
-        # graph partitions. These buffers should also be a partition
-        # input.
-        extra_input_names = [
-            name
-            for name in (buffer_names_to_free - output_names)
-            if name in name_to_node
-        ]
-        partition_input_names.update(extra_input_names)
-
-        input_nodes = {
-            name: name_to_node[name]
-            for name in partition_input_names
-            if name in name_to_node
-        }
-        input_deallocation = {
-            name: name in buffer_names_to_free
-            for name in partition_input_names
-            if name in name_to_node
-        }
-
-        # if an input tensor is not freed in the partition function, it should
-        # also be returned as an output. This brings benefits to cudagraph
-        # since the returned output tensor is a cudagraph managed tensor with
-        # a static tensor address.
-        extra_output_names = [
-            name
-            for name in partition_input_names
-            if name in name_to_node and name not in buffer_names_to_free
-        ]
-
-        returned_output_names.update(extra_output_names)
-
-        returned_output_names = OrderedSet(
-            self.mutation_real_name.get(name, name) for name in returned_output_names
-        )
-
-        output_nodes = [
-            name_to_node[name]
-            for name in returned_output_names
-            if not is_none_layout(name)
-        ]
-
-        constant_names = [
-            name for name in partition_input_names if name in V.graph.constants
-        ]
-
-        symbol_inputs = self.get_graph_partition_symbol_inputs(partition, input_nodes)
-
-        partition_signature = GraphPartitionSignature(
-            symbol_inputs,
-            input_nodes,
-            output_nodes,
-            input_deallocation,
-            skip_cudagraph,
-            constant_names,
-        )
-
-        signatures.append(partition_signature)
-
-        unmet_output_names = partition_input_names.union(
-            unmet_output_names - returned_output_names
-        )
-
-    return signatures[::-1]
